Name: Fish Fever
Author: duckbase
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52305/52305-1790081558-1738842508.png[/img]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds 30 brand new fish to the game. They've been added to a plethora of locations in the game, so make sure to cast your fishing rod often. This mod adds 6 legendary fish, 3 standard and 3 variants catchable during a new quest offered by Mr.Qi. All fish in this mod can be added to fish ponds, each having unique colours, the legendary fish only produce roe but the rest of them have distinct produced items. Additionally, all fish come with aquarium sprites, below are three of them.[/color][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52305/52305-1790064316-1841107970.gif[/img]

[list=1]
[*][color=#d4d4d8] Install [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][color=#d4d4d8], make sure you download download the latest version. [/color][/*]
